caption: The drawing depicts a nautical compass housed within an open rectangular wooden frame. The compass features a prominently large circular face marked with black and white alternating triangles pointing toward cardinal and intercardinal directions, along with corresponding letters for the cardinal points (N, S, E, W, NE, NW, SE, SW, etc.). At the center of the compass, additional decorative elements and text, including “R.L. SHAW,” are visible. The outer casing of the compass is depicted in metallic tones with shading that suggests a reflective domed glass or metal cover. The wooden frame is colored in natural wood tones with visible grain and weathering, and the overall orientation shows the compass tilted downward and held within the open structure. In the bottom left corner, there is a small, rough sketch of the same compass and frame viewed from a similar angle, drawn in light gray pencil lines. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or adornment.
title: Compass
